accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Records more than 20 years old are open for research with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.
All users seeking access to the fellowship files must complete a usage agreement prior to being granted access to the collection. See RAC Head of Reference for details.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Foundation has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.
